name: jctosta-toolbox
description: Personal toolbox of Claude Code plugins: a spec-first development workflow, a qlty quality gate, a Vale prose gate, and a pi subagent

plugins.name: spec-workflow
plugins.description: Spec-first development workflow: define-app, explore, refine, design, test-spec, feedback, status — artifacts validated before code, with traceability lint and a local review site

plugins.name: quality-gate
plugins.description: Guided qlty setup: assess a project, decide which checks and thresholds actually matter, then enforce them as a quality gate in CI, git hooks and agent instructions — with the reasoning committed alongside the config

plugins.name: prose-gate
plugins.description: Guided Vale setup aimed at the prose agents write — preamble, self-narration, marketing adjectives, hedging, sign-offs. Profiles a repo, decides which rules earn their noise, then enforces them while an agent writes rather than after the fact

plugins.name: pi-subagent
plugins.description: Delegate small, well-scoped tasks to the pi coding agent (pi.dev) on a cheap model and parse its JSON event stream into one result: final answer, files touched, tool calls, tokens and cost
